### CI diagnosis — payment audit runner environment

The latest completed CI on `19af56e441e51c2ca9a378b967f07872d4d2c993` is **not green**: [run 35114623785](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/35114623785), backend job `104857160527`.

- Compilation and the Haskell suite completed: **2,555 examples, zero failures**.
- The subsequent mandatory PostgreSQL payment audit failed at `scripts/test-payment-audit-runtime.sh:7`: `docker: not found`, exit 127.
- The backend job runs inside `haskell:9.10.3-bookworm`, which has PostgreSQL client tools and an existing PostgreSQL service but no Docker CLI. The audit script unconditionally starts a Docker container.
- The aggregate `quality` failure is downstream. Later backend runtime/migration/concurrency steps did not run and are not counted as passes.
- The same cause occurred on prior head `790b239760206cec0c88e2aae29838fa4b4c3fa6` in [run 35057165813](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/35057165813), after 2,554 passing examples. This is deterministic; a rerun without a change is not a fix.

The repair should use an isolated, newly created database on CI's existing PostgreSQL service, retain the Docker-backed local path, and keep the actual payment-audit tests mandatory with failure propagation. A concurrent local repair already addresses this environment mismatch; I am preserving that work and have not pushed my overlapping alternative. No jobs were stopped, no push hold requested, and no PR merge or auto-merge performed.

Fresh successful CI on the repaired final SHA is still required. This note is a diagnosis, not completion evidence.

# CI continuation — September 16, 2026

Verified at September 16, approximately19:13 UTC: current PR checks and current main workflows are green. This does not assert every original completion criterion: latest-head full native backend/container validation was not repeated, and review conversations remain unresolved.

## Scope and commits

- Original audit main: `17a33eca11d585d84435af85340beece9b51d14e`.
- Latest evaluated main: `d4bd497df6979f639dcd112e4f60b57f3526b9e0`.
- Originally scoped [PR #331](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/pull/331): `35a92e04b1f3f1a7def3f9c126d19cde3d00b5c3`, open, mergeable, auto-merge off at last refresh.
- Published mobile branch: [`fix/payment-main-client-integration-20260916`](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-mobile/tree/fix/payment-main-client-integration-20260916), merge commit `6093556c6f35037cdd4b2071bdc0401bf1d5ad5a`. Both parents, `337d46f25a8b7c7c688aa3657ffb599ecb4c47c7` and `bd918826fae055b51f96870fcf297920b78a2376`, are preserved. PR331 pins this commit.
- Another session published the integration and overlapping CI repair while local validation was underway. This session verified them and did not push a duplicate branch or superseded repair.
- Original correction [#333](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/pull/333) and follow-up [#376](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/pull/376) were merged externally. This agent did not merge either or enable auto-merge. Historical follow-up final SHA: `d8577d3af100ccbac7cf31702b877814e55546f8`.

## Latest workflow evidence

| Workflow/check | Before | Current evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PR backend and aggregate | Missing Docker in job container; subsequently 9 failures from early audit fixture activation and globally scoped PostgreSQL password | [CI35132218326](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/35132218326): SUCCESS;2558 examples/0 failures, then4 payment-audit examples/0 failures and explicit PostgreSQL boundary PASS |
| PR UI/mobile/persona/repository/API/migrations | Original application, migration, generator and browser defects; repaired in prior corrections | Same current CI: all these completed component jobs passed |
| PR catalog | Attempt1 exceeded 10-minute limit; log unavailable with BlobNotFound | [Attempt2](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/35132218116/attempts/2): SUCCESS, unchanged SHA, timeout and strict audit; audit step 65 seconds |

| Main catalog | Original159 unreviewed/9 stale decisions repaired with evidence | [35130568267](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/35130568267): SUCCESS |

| Main artist enrichment | MusicBrainz503 exhaustion; bounded retries and evidence-preserving withholding | [35132361929](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/35132361929): SUCCESS, dry-run, no automatic publication |
| Main Instagram lifecycle | Unsupported provider debugger and identity parsing/binding repaired | [35132357904](https://github.com/diegueins680/tdf-app/actions/runs/35132357904): SUCCESS, read-only check |

## Current root causes and repairs

1. CI backend runs in a Haskell container without Docker. The published runtime helper now supports CI's existing PostgreSQL service and an owned disposable test database while retaining local Docker support. The mandatory payment audit assertions and `--fail-on=empty` remain.
2. Enabling `TDF_PAYMENT_AUDIT_DATABASE_URL` before fixture creation activated database specs too early. The initial Stack invocation now removes that variable; the runtime runner applies its fixture before activating database assertions.
3. Job-wide `PGPASSWORD` polluted configuration test isolation. CI uses `TDF_TEST_POSTGRES_PASSWORD`; the runtime child scopes `PGPASSWORD` to its disposable database execution. Ownership and password-scope regressions are published.
4. Main and payment branches had diverged mobile history. The normal merge preserves both, and canonical API generation validates the new requester-name fields without discarding payment changes.
5. Catalog attempt1 timed out without retrievable logs. The exact strict audit passed locally; the one permitted diagnostic rerun passed unchanged in65 seconds. This supports a transient runner problem, not a governance defect. No repeated retries or timeout relaxation.

Relevant published files: `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `scripts/quality-backend.sh`, `scripts/test-payment-audit-runtime.sh`, `scripts/lib/postgres-test-database.sh`, `scripts/__tests__/ci-pipeline.test.mjs`, canonical/generated API contracts, catalog reports, and the `tdf-mobile` gitlink. The larger payment feature was authored in the concurrent session; this report does not claim authorship of it.

## Local validation and limits

- Exact Node22.14.0 root `npm ci --no-audit --no-fund`: PASS; committed lockfile unchanged.
- Mobile locked installation: PASS. Pinned Node20.19.4 lint and typecheck: PASS.
- Mobile final full tests on published609 tree: 68 suites/329 tests PASS, exit0. An earlier full run had one5-second timeout under heavy measured host contention; one isolated diagnostic14/14 passed, followed by the full329-test pass. No deadline/assertion/exclusion changed.
- Exact35a `npm run quality:repo`: PASS, exit0.
- Exact35a strict catalog command with `--fail-on-unreviewed`: PASS, exit0;1117 candidates/1410 files. Existing decisions unchanged.
- Canonical UI/mobile generation: PASS, no unexpected generated diff. Focused access-request UI tests12/12 PASS.
- Locally developed orchestration regressions demonstrated both configuration failures before passing25/25. Extra local tests remain in an unpublished superseded checkpoint; published35a has its own regression suite. Do not treat those extra local tests as pushed.
- Exact35a `npm run quality:ui`: PASS, exit0. Lint, typecheck,209 suites/2001 tests, production build and bundle budget passed. Initial JS314733 gzip bytes/5 preloads. Log `/private/tmp/tdf-pr331-35a-ui-quality.log`.
- Native full backend, migration and Docker suites were previously validated for the original corrections; no new full native backend/container result is claimed for35a. Fresh hosted exact-SHA results remain required.
- Separate actionlint capability was unavailable; YAML parsing and repository workflow guards passed, not a substitute claim that actionlint ran.

## Safeguards and operational scope

No PR merge, auto-merge, force push, other-job pause, production deployment or destructive production operation. No secret value printed or committed. One own disposable PostgreSQL probe container was stopped after its tests; other jobs/services were untouched.

No test/security/governance threshold weakened. Catalog decisions were not bulk-approved. No migrations added by this continuation; owned test database cleanup cannot authorize a production cleanup. Mobile integration is compatible additive generated contract data. Rollback of this integration can use a reviewed revert/pin change without rewriting either history.

Legitimate conditional steps include read-only token mode skipping refresh/deployment and manual enrichment dry-run skipping scheduled production publication. Full main image dispatch selects every reusable CI component. Other active workflow definitions introduced only on later branches, and optional GitHub-managed Copilot executions, are not automatic gates in these evaluated trees.

Final refresh: PR331 remains open/non-draft/mergeable at35a, base and current main d4bd, auto-merge null. All17 reported PR checks are successful, including Cloudflare/Vercel previews. Current main has7 successful workflow executions, with CI fully exercised through the12-job Build Image workflow. No final pending, failed or canceled workflow remains; the catalog's historical canceled attempt is retained and explained above.

Remaining review gate: GitHub reports `mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED`. The branch requires conversation resolution;5 of20 review threads are unresolved despite an approved review. No thread was marked resolved by this continuation. Reviewers must evaluate and resolve addressed conversations; no merge or protection bypass is authorized. The branch's traditional required-status-check setting is absent; this audit still verified all applicable reported checks rather than treating that absence as success.

Native full backend/container validation on latest35a was not repeated here; fresh hosted backend, runtime, migrations, contracts and main container validation passed. This is a precise local-validation limitation, not a claim that local tests failed or that an external credential is missing. Original correction PRs333/376 were already merged by other actors, so this cannot honestly be presented as an open standalone correction PR. The currently open original-scope PR is331.

Final open-PR inventory contains70 PRs; only331 belongs to the original PR scope. Later-created PRs were inventoried but not silently added. No external credential blocker is currently proven, and no automatic deployment or merge is requested by these results.
